summary: Core Valentine single-page UI with Yes/No choices, evasive No behavior, and a celebration overlay is implemented. However, the required generated image assets are not shown as added in the diff, and the branding config requirement is only partially met (site name/title not clearly driven from the central config). Several unrequested authentication/actor/query features and a promotional footer were added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a simple configuration mechanism for branding text so the site name/title and the Valentine’s Day message can be changed without rewriting components.
missing_requirements.reason: A central config exists, but the site name/title does not appear to be rendered from it. The HTML <title> is hardcoded and not connected to the config, and App.tsx does not display valentineConfig.siteName.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add required static image assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: The UI references the required image paths, but the diff does not show the actual image files being added under frontend/public/assets/generated, so existence of required assets cannot be verified from the diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication provider and related auth hook/context added.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly says third-party auth is a non-goal and Internet Identity is not required for this app; these auth files and provider usage are not requested by any REQ.

hallucinated_features.description: Actor creation/query management via react-query (useActor hook) added.
hallucinated_features.reason: No backend interaction requirements were requested; the Valentine page is purely frontend behavior per REQ-1..REQ-6.

hallucinated_features.description: Promotional footer linking to caffeine.ai added.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in the BuildRequest requirements/acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: Use of lucide-react Heart icon component.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; the BuildRequest only required using provided static images for background/fireworks/sparkles.
